q: The area law for 1D gapped local Hamiltonians (Hastings 2007) says the entanglement entropy S(ρ_A) across a bipartition satisfies:
opts: S(ρ_A) = O(1) (area law — constant, independent of subsystem size)
exp: Hastings (2007): for gapped 1D local Hamiltonians, S(ρ_A) ≤ C (a constant). Entanglement is bounded by the boundary (one point for 1D), not the volume. This justifies MPS (matrix product state) representations and shows 1D quantum ground states are 'simple'.
